Okubo's mother, often ill, does not bring enough money into her household, so Okubo holds a job in order to support the household. They also appear in the Chapter Black Saga where they attend the Megallica concert with Kuwabara. On their way home they are attacked by Kiyoshi Mitarai aka Seaman and nearly drown in one of Seaman's water-based monsters, but are saved by Kuwabara. Afterwards Kuwabara carries the three on his back along with Mitarai to Yusuke Urameshi's apartment before passing out. After Kirishima, Okubo, and Sawamura tell Kurama about what happened, Kurama erased their memories of this event so they would not be burdened with it and sent them home. In the first character popularity poll, Kirishima ranked 9th place with 219 votes.

name: Sayaka
about: Sayaka is the person who was sent by Koenma to do an investigation on Yusuke. If you think about it, Sayaka was the one who sparked Yusuke and Keiko's relationship. The only time she is ever seen is in one episode.  In the manga, Sayaka is a spirit of a lonely girl who's parents didn't know how to take care of her. In her loneliness she kept taking the soul of Shota, and because Shota didn't have any sixth sense, it was slowly killing him.  Fortunately, Yususke and Botan managed to knock some sense in her and she left Shota alone after he promised to play with her in Heaven when he gets there. She then hangs out with Yususke, and during that time she tests his and Keiko's love for each other.

name: Sakamoto
about: Leader of a rival gang that took over much of the territory that belonged to Urameshi prior to his death. During the take over time, Sakamoto was taken over by a demon who turned out to be Yusuke's first capture after returning to the land of the living.

name: Gouki
about: Gouki is a member of Hiei's underworld gang who is a soul-eating ogre. Yusuke defeats him with a powered-up Reigun blast to the mouth. His humanoid form is a tall, intimidating man, but he still has horns along his forehead. His true form is more demon like, his horns are larger and his fangs and eyes become larger. After his fight with Yusuke he is arrested. He is a Upper E Class demon.

name: Shiori Minamino
about: Shiori Minamino is the human mother of Shuichi Minamino (Kurama). She is a very loving mother, as evidenced by Kurama growing attached enough to her emotionally to go to great lengths to ensure her health and safety, such as wishing for her to recover from a serious illness on the Forlorn Hope even though he knew it would take his own life as a price.

name: Baldok
about: Bat Master, also know as Bat Tamer (Japanese version) or Baldock (English Anime) is a demon in the form of a large bat with a human head and a bowtie. He is in charge of a large number of bats in Genkai's forest and is under Genkai's command. He is the demon who fights Yusuke in Genkai's third test, and Yusuke manages to defeat it.

name: Kazemaru
about: Kaze-maru is one of the many people who tried to learn Genkai's techniques. He is a VIP bodyguard and one of the last of the ninja. He managed to make it to the Semi-Finals of the fourth test, where he fought Yusuke, and lost. He is skilled to a degree in physical abilities, and he can also use the Reigun better than Yusuke could at the time. Kaze-maru also has tracker shuriken that will continue to hunt the first thing with reiki that they are thrown at. Each tip of the shuriken is also loaded with gunpowder so that when they hit something, they explode.   In the English anime his name is spelled Kazamaru.

name: Kibano
about: Kibano is one of the many people who tried to learn Genkai's techniques. He fought Yusuke in the fourth test and compensated for his poor (on par with Yusuke's) spirit awareness by wearing a special helmet that blocked out his senses of hearing, sight, and smell to enhance these abilities. He can increase the size of his arm muscles and is very skilled at physical techniques. Yusuke beat him with his Spirit Gun by placing Genkai's discarded cigarette on his belt to use as a marker.

name: Musashi
about: Musashi is one of the many people who tried to learn Genkai's techniques. Musashi fought Kuwabara in the fourth test and lost. Musashi has the ability to mask his spirit emissions so that he can't be seen in the dark by people with high spirit awareness (such as Kuwabara). He also uses a sword carved from a holy tree washed in a sacred stream. When a piece of it broke off, Kuwabara used it and discovered his Spirit Sword abilities.

name: Hunter J
about: Hunter J is a person who is willing to do anything to capture Pokémon for her clients even if it means injuring people or Pokémon, easily revealing her to be ruthless, relentless, and cruel. In fact, in her debut episode, she sacrificed some of her henchmen to Officer Jenny without hesitation or remorse, emphasizing her sociopathic and callous nature.  J appeared again in DP150, where she was hired by Team Galactic to catch Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf. She also appeared in DP151, attempting to carry out the task of capturing them. Although she did succeed in capturing the Lake guardians, her ship was hit by two Future Sight attacks used by Uxie and Mesprit after she handed them over to Saturn. As a result, her ship crashed into Lake Valor and was sucked into a whirlpool while she and her crew members were on board. Once the ship was underwater, the protective glass broke and the ship was flooded with water, causing it to explode. It is currently unknown if J or any of her crew survived.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

name: Himiko
about: Cameo appearances in Shin Koihime Musou: Episode 6 Episode 10  Visual novel version A new character in Shin Koihime Musō. A white-haired mustached man wearing a loincloth under a blazer (instead of a woman in the historical novel, depicted as the queen of Wa (the ancient Chinese name of Japan)) who shows up in the special campaign unlocked after completing the campaigns of the three warring factions. Apparently has a history with Chōsen. He and Chōsen, along with Kata, travel throughout China, encountering, the (female) generals and warriors from the various factions, often scaring them with their hilarious antics, sometimes to the point where the generals/warriors (and their regiment) end up too frightened to fight in combat. Himiko also makes a cameo appearance (as a shadowed mystery man) at the end of the Go campaign right after the last battle of the campaign when Sōsō's forces are finally defeated.  (Source: Wikipedia)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Kakuka Houkou
about: Anime Version A woman seeking to become a strategist of Sōsō's forces, and is also romantically attracted to the warlord. She ends up becoming Sōsō's bodyguard instead, much to her chargin. Later her talent as a strategist is accepted by Sōsō who realizes she's much suitable to be her strategist. Teiiku calls her Icchan (いっちゃん).  Visual Novel Version A bespectacled female strategist and a new character in the sequel, Shin Koihime Musō. She easily gets nosebleeds when having perverted thoughts, and as a result is sometimes found passed out on the ground and often mistaken to be dead (due to a pool of blood from her nosebleeding).  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Tei'iku Chuutoku
about: In the anime, she is Kakuka's companion who tries her best to keep Kakuka out of trouble, often cleaning up the messes she makes from her nosebleed episodes. She's a good ventriloquist, usually utilizing it on her head ornament she named Houkei. She is also seeking to serve under Sousou as a strategist, and is accepted as such.  In the visual novel, she is the silent adviser girl and a new character in the sequel, Shin Koihime Musou. She is most notable for always carrying a lollipop, as well as wearing a head ornament that somehow reflects her emotions.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ten'i
about: Anime Version A girl encountered by Kan'u's group working as a chef at a tavern in the Gi kingdom in Shin Koihime Musō. Sōsō learned about her when Rinrin accidentally blurted out liking Teni's food better, so Sōsō gave her a test to compare her cooking skills against her own. Sōsō was not so impressed at first, until Kan'u's group noticed Teni prepared the dishes with food they liked at her tavern, and Sōsō conceeded defeat. Then when a raging bull crashed the scene, Teni surprised eveyone with her immense strength when she literally grabbed the bull by the horns and hurled it out of Sōsō's palace, earning her an invitation to join Sōsō's army.   Visual Novel Version A new character who wields a yoyo as a weapon in the sequel, Shin Koihime Musō. Kyocho's friend and frequent sparring partner. The two of them tend to cause a lot of property damage during their sparring sessions. Like Kyocho, she sees Kazuto as a big brother, calling him 'Nii-san'.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yokozuna
about: Yokozuna is a giant sumo-wrestling frog, who was a friend (as well as pet) to the legendary shipwright Tom until Tom's execution. After that, he would always swim through the waters around Water 7, stepping in the way of the Sea Train to try and stop it. This habit is said to be caused by Yokozuna wanting to become stronger so he won't lose anymore of his loved ones. In fact, when he was first introduced, he was performing this very routine when Zoro spotted him from the Going Merry; after informing the rest of his crew about the giant frog swimming in a manner not unlike to a human, Luffy decided to slightly change course (they were headed to the next island, which happens to be Water 7) to capture the giant frog so his crew could have a nice barbecue meal. This habit also caused him to try and stop the Rocket Man while the Straw Hat Pirates, Galley-La Foremen, and Franky Family were traveling towards Enies Lobby, and he ends up helping them in their attempt to get Franky and Nico Robin back. While on Enies Lobby, he is in charge of preventing any government agents from getting into the courthouse, and does well until the Jurors arrive and attack. He is then saved by the giants Oimo and Kaashii, who decide to help him guard the courthouse. Yokozuna boarded the sea train with the Franky Family, the Galley-La, and the giants and has since returned to Water 7. He was recently seen in a "where are they now" title page, no longer challenging the Sea Train.  Franky taught Yokozuna to use crawl-stroke when swimming.  First Appearance: Chapter 322; Episode 228   (Source: One Piece Wiki)

name: Yamakaji
about: Vice-Admiral Yamakaji (ヤマカジ中将, Yamakaji Chūjō) is one of the five Vice-admirals who lead the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.   He seems to smile at all times, even during a Buster Call. He is also a smoker of cigars, just as Onigumo smokes cigarettes. His eyes are always closed and has a big brown beard.   (Source: One Piece Wikia)

name: Nurikabe
about: Nurikabe is a large, sleepy-eyed wall-shaped youkai, who uses his massive size to protect Kitaro and his friends. The original Nurikabe is a spirit which blocks the passage of people walking at night. Nurikabe first appears in a cameo as one of many youkai attending a sukiyaki party in the story A Walk to Hell (Rental version) before making a more prominent appearance in The Great Youkai War (Shounen Magazine version). In the 2002 Kodansha International Bilingual Comics edition, he is referred to as Wally Wall.

name: Naoya Shirokawa
about: Age: 17 Height: 180 cm Weight: 73 kg Blood Type: B Class: 2-5 Special Skill: Physical strength  Naoya Shirokawa is a male student at Seika High School who initially dislikes Misaki because of her forceful methods of reforming Seika. He and his friends discover that she works at a maid café early on in the story, but after he is defeated by Usui, they quickly become her biggest fans, as well as regulars at Cafe Maid Latte, often referred to as the "idiot trio." His nickname is "Shiroyan." He also used to be a delinquent in middle school known as White Demon.

name: Hodr
about: Age: 25  Hodr is the King of Krisna and Sigyn's husband. He befriended Rygart and Zess at the military school when he ditched class to help them save an owl after he spotted the two from his classroom's window. He was known to stare at the sky and had poor grades. He doesn't want to be king, but tries to be a good leader and cares greatly for his people's lives.

name: Zess
about: Age: 25  Zess is a soldier of Athens. He was one of the best pilots at military school and was called "straight-laced Zess."   When he learns his nation plans to conquer Krisna, he leads a small commando strike force of mechs to the Krisna capital in order to make Hodr surrender quickly to spare his friends and their country from the wrath of the main Athens Invasion Army, unaware that the leaders of Athens want the royal family executed.   He is married and has a two-year-old daughter.

name: Shiina
about: Shiina, otherwise referred to by his nickname Shii, is another adult friend of Shūichi and Yoshino. He was Yuki's classmate in elementary school, and he eventually became her boyfriend after her transition and due to her persistence. Unlike Yuki, Shii had many friends in school. He generally just watches over Shūichi and Yoshino with Yuki, but he does sometimes do bold and unexpected things, such as grabbing Yoshino's crotch when the two of them first meet because he feared that she, who was dressed as a boy at the time, might be Yuki's illicit lover in an affair.

name: Hiroyuki Yoshida
about: Hiroyuki, otherwise referred to as Yuki, is a tall and attractive transgender woman in a relationship with her boyfriend Shii. Yuki takes an early interest in Yoshino when she believes him to be a cis boy, though remains on good terms with him even after learning of his assigned sex. Yuki sees a lot of herself in Shuuichi, though there are several major differences between their situations. When Yuki was growing up, Shii was the only friend who stood by her while the girls would tease her, and the boys would bully her to change.  Yuki dislikes cooking anything, though she runs a gay bar. She always keeps up a positive attitude, and can easily understand what Shuuichi and Yoshino are going through; as such, she is often able to give helpful advice when they are troubled. Her parents run a uniform store, and as she has not been on good terms with her family since her transition, it has been a long time since she has been to her former home.   In the Takako Shimura's short story collection Boku wa, Onna no ko, Yuki is the main character of the story "Hana." Yuki's family—which consists of her father, mother, brother, and sister-in-law—appears here, and Yuki is revealed to be a fan of Keiji Sata, a Showa period actor.

name: Akauma
about: He is the leader of the bandits who attacked Shukumaru's village.

name: Chan Lee
about: She first appears when she goes to Masquerade's "party", falling under the control of Naga. Then, she faces off against Dan, but loses and leaves thinking that Dan did well but that she has a secret weapon. She faces Dan, Runo and Marucho alongside Julio and Klaus.They lose when Marucho activates the Fire, Water, Light Triple Node and Runo's Cut-in-Saber ability card, making Drago evolve. They are then freed from Naga's control. Along with the others Masquerade sends her Fortress to the Doom Dimension but it is later returned to her.   She then stalls Centorrior when the Battle Brawlers are in Vestroia.   She develops a crush on Joe and saves him from Hal-G.(Dan and Julie also made fun of Chan saying that Chan and Joe were dating )At the end of the series, they are seen dating in the bench in the background.  (Source: bakugan.wikia.com)

about: He is the patient in episode 7 the young leader of his yakuza group. He is afraid of pointing things to the extreme that he needed to see Irabu.

name: Yuu
about: Yū only appears in Yukine's path. Wanting to locate his sister, who is a delinquent, he meets up with Yukine. His mother escorts him later, leaving bad remarks on Tomoya, Youhei and Yukine.

name: Tooru Shiga
about: Daisuke Godo's loyal partner. He is the brains of the operations while Daisuke is the brawns. He once vowed to take care of Daisuke's sister if anything ever happened to him.

name: Jinzaburou Matoba
about: The man from the Japanese Government who hires Shinichi to the task of spreading the Japanese culture in Eldant. However, he only reveals him the true nature of his mission after having him drugged and taken away from Earth.

name: Galious En Koldobar
name_kanji: ガリウス・エン・コルドバル
about: Galious appears very reluctant to allow the "otaku culture" to be introduced into his world and calls Shin'ichi Kanō a "poison" to their world.   He is the cousin of the Empress Petralka Anne Eldante III.

name: Dogura
about: Dogura is the owner of Branwen, the captured dragon warrior.  As a slave trader, Dogura must do what he can to ensure those under his captivity satisfy his goals. He is rather harsh with his subjects, thus ensuring they fight harder for him. He may even free a subject if they are able to overcome what he has asked of them.  For a bit of prestige, cheap wine and praise from the beautiful Swamp Witch, he forces Branwen to fight day after day without mercy.  He is voiced by Binbin Takaoka.  (Source: queensblade.wikia)

name: Chris Yuu Takigawa
about: Age: 18-19 Position: Catcher Bats: Right Throws: Right First Appearance: Chapter 18, Episode 7  Chris Takigawa is a third-year student and a member of the Seidou High School Baseball Team. Because of a shoulder injury he had to take a year of for rehabilitation and lost his position as the starting catcher, but the coach asked him to stay in the position of a manager to guide the team.  He has a gloomy aura around him and all the first years think that he is hard to handle. It is revealed that many pitchers have quit because of him. He is strong willed because as long as a single strand of hope remains, he will never give up on baseball.  (Source: Diamond no Ace Wikia)

name: Kenji Iwaki
about: Tomonori's father. He is a typical salaryman with 30-years house loan on his shoulders. By Papas' State Power he was promoted to department manager position.  In the anime, he has a bondage and hadaka apron fetish.

name: Tadaomi Shirotani
about: Age: 31  Shirotani works in the Tosawa Corporation. He suffers from mysophobia since he was a child. He has short strawberry blonde hair. His eyes are in a light shade of brown and he has a mole under his right eye. Outside he wears a suit with gloves, many times covered with long beige jacket.  He is seen as rude, inconsiderate or even arrogant person, but he really has a low self-esteem and deeply cares about others. He tries to stay away from people because he doesn't want to hurt anybody with  his mysophobia; which is why he blamed himself so much when his boss got hurt in an accident. This traumatic experience and Kurose Riku's help made Shirotani work on his mysophobia. He's currently trying exposure therapy with Kurose's help, who is also a counsellor in a clinic called Shimada Psychosomatics.

name: Riku Kurose
about: Age: 26  A psychiatrist currently curing Shirotani from his mysophobia.

about: Aicho, also called Aicho the Sky (空の藍朓 Sora no Aichou), is the former 10th Ninku corps (酉忍 Tori-nin, the rooster Ninku) captain and has extremely strong legs with an attitude to match, enabling him to cover large distances in a single bound and cause big damage on enemy machinery through his techniques. He also hates women, as this can be seen in his attitude towards Touji's sister, who has a crush on him. He also considers Touji an idiot.  (Source: Wikipedia)

about: The 3rd-year student council president. He has known Taisuke since they were in the same elementary school. He has an interest in Hiwako.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Ten likes boys, according to him it could be said that he made a dramatic realization after his older brother, En, started cross-dressing. He feels that his brother's hobby is really regretful. He is in agreement that En looks much better dressed like a guy. In chapter nine during the Christmas party, he and Hinata tried to strip En. Hinata cross-dressing is Ten's ideal man. about: Leutschekta "Loi" is a youkai with the appearance of a goat. He is almost sacrificed by humans after they assume he is responsible for the plague affecting their village, but is saved at the last minute by the god Xiuhtecuhtli, who turns him into a human and takes him as a companion. Loi has a kind personality and works hard to exorcise spirits in order to help humans, despite Xiu worrying about his safety.  No voice actors have been added to this character. In the human world, he works as an idol.  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Miko
about: Along with her best friend Mako, Miko was a fanatical fan of an idol named Yu-Yu.  When Yu-Yu committed suicide, both Miko and Mako were quick to follow in his death as soon as possible, though they don't seem particularly remorseful about it.  (Source: Wonder Egg Priority Wiki)

name: Yamashiro
about: Yamashiro is an antagonist in one of the stories in Azur Lane. Her real life counterpart is IJN Yamashiro, a Japanese battleship known for her difficulty to be manipulated.  Yamashiro is a very clumsy catgirl, tripping on herself or tending to break things by accident. She is considered as unlucky, like her sister, and her clumsiness is what references to the difficulty of manipulating Yamashiro correctly. She even fires with her guns without always wanting it. She knows how to practice Kagura, a traditional Japanese dance, and takes care of a shrine. Her mask in her hair is also a Kagura mask.

He physically assaults Nanjō inside Maki's stasis room after Nanjō suggests killing Maki in order to sever her control over them.  He wields an axe as his melee weapon. He also uses shotguns. His initial Persona is Ogun. In addition to his school uniform, Masao wears a yellow tuque.  Masao appears in Persona 3 on the TV program 'Who's Who,' a show about previous Persona characters and what they are doing now. He is introduced as a "Man in his 20's with a yellow cap" and the program goes on to say that he is studying art overseas.  The fictional city in Persona 4 is named Inaba, a likely reference to Masao's family name. She forms part of the new Getter team alongside Go and Gai, piloting the Shin Getter-2. She is truly the daughter of Professor Saotome, raised as a boy until she became amnesiac and Benkei took her in.

name: Benkei Kuruma

name: Hayato Jin
about: The second pilot of Getter Robo, Hayato is portrayed as a psychopathic yet highly intelligent delinquent. He is first seen as the leader of a student revolutionary group but is captured by the Saotome Research Institute after a fight with Ryoma and pulled into the Getter Robo storyline, initially as the pilot of Getter-2. He is the only character to have appeared in every Getter Robo series and has fulfilled many roles, from being a regular teenager to an adult colonel and an aging scientist.  Like the other Getter Robo characters, his portrayal is drastically different in the 1970s TV series. While still a rebel and a loner, he is far less cold and cruel.

He suffers from amnesia and has no idea who he was, he even made up his own name. Despite his unknown past, he is cheerful, wild, and reckless. He is likened to the dog from Bremen, since he behaves as badly as a stray dog.  No voice actors have been added to this character. name: Kiyokazu Fujimoto
about: A blunt, reserved young man working at the same kindergarten as Kobato. He is also Kobato's neighbor, living in the same complex under the ownership of Chitose. He has known Sayaka for many years and appears to have strong feelings for her, showing much concern over and being fiercely defensive of her. Upon first meeting Kobato, he is rather suspicious of the unusual girl, as he does not want Sayaka to be hurt by another person. He often pokes fun at and teases Kobato, which is unusual as he generally ignores people he does not like; as a result, Sayaka interprets his actions toward the girl as affection. Regardless of his initial distrust of Kobato, he has shown signs of warming up to her and now seems to care about her well being, demonstrated when once she pretended to have a cold to cover up for Ioryogi, and Fujimoto in response discreetly passed on a bag of cough drops to her. Kobato notes that he appears to be hiding some emotional pain of his own.

name: Katsuhiko Jinnai
about: Katsuhiko Jinnai (陣内 克彦 Jinnai Katsuhiko), manages to win the Student Body Presidential election by promising student government funds to campus clubs and organizations that voted for him.  When Makoto catches wind of this and plans are made for him to testify against Jinnai (who is called "Jinnai" by everyone except his sister), the egocentric, power-hungry and soon-to-be-impeached Student Body President attempts to thwart the process by attacking Makoto, intending to keep him tied up until a technicality in the bylaws prevents him from being thrown out of office. Before he can execute his plan, however, he's sent to El-Hazard, and once there encounters the Bugrom, a race of human-sized insectoid beings ruled by Queen Diva.  Jinnai's power granted to him by the trip is the ability to communicate with the Bugrom, allowing him to become their military commander under their belief that he is the messenger from God sent to lead the Bugrom to victory. A skilled tactician, he is able to reorganize the Bugrom forces into an effective army and comes close to conquering El-Hazard.  Although Jinnai is a power-hungry egomaniac, he's not without some level of humanity. When Galus attempts to stop Makoto and the others from halting the Eye of God's apocalyptic malfunction, he takes the leader of the Phantom Tribe by surprise with the help of a Bugrom soldier. Although Jinnai effectively comes to Makoto and Nanami's rescue, he does so more for the fact that a "true ruler doesn't destroy the land he wishes to conquer." Jinnai has a very distinctive laugh.  Jinni suffers from an obsession with Makoto that borders of the psychotic. Over the course of both series, he consistently blames Makoto for essentially every single failure and disappointment he experiences. His sense of his own history is a montage of misfortune, the chief architect of which is Makoto. Though generally megalomaniacal, one of his primary motivations in gaining power is to subsequently gain the ability to best, or, even kill him.  Jinnai in The Wanderers  Jinnai does not change much in the transition from OVA to TV series, either, but he seems to treat Ifurita with more care. Although he's threatened with impeachment from his position as Student Body President at the beginning of the series and Makoto plays no direct role in the trial, he is paranoid that Makoto will replace him as president once he is kicked out of office.  Additionally, Jinnai reveals a softer side at the end of the series, showing a certain fatherly affection towards Ifurita after she stops the Eye of God from plowing into Roshtaria.   ~From Wikipedia

He is somewhat sensitive, comical and has a weak exterior although people believe he has determination out of this world. As the story progresses he does not change much in the way he looks at his targets and his way of life. He does have several romantic interests in the show but you'll just have to watch to see what will happen.

Like a faithful dog, he follows his mistress wherever she goes and generally follows her orders. Amane sees their relationship as purely business, but Hyoue’s feelings for her are more amorous than those of a pet for his master.  Hyoue’s human body is a disguise--his true form is that of a fiery lion beast. He draws energy from Amane’s lifeforce—without it, he grows weak. Her kiss literally brings out the demon in him! name: Reiji Mitsurugi
about: Reiji Mitsurugi is an esteemed prosecutor and an old friend of Ryuuichi Naruhodou. During his first four years as a prosecutor, he had a perfect win record, and he was a ruthless man who would do anything to get a guilty verdict for the defendant. He was adopted by his mentor, Manfred Von Karma, after the death of his father in the DL-6 case.             Mitsurugi is generally seen as a snob due to his skeptical, ruthless and generally aloof nature that differs little between everyday life and the courtroom. However, he has a strong sense of right and wrong, and acts only in ways that he believes are fair and just.   Generally, Mitsurugi is calm and level-headed when talking with people, although he does tend to come off as a little cold and, sometimes, rather condescending.  In court, Mitsurugi usually has the trial precisely planned out, ensuring his victory. Because of this, he tends to become easily ruffled with anything that does not conform to his plan. In particular, he tries to stick to standard courtroom proceedings, trying to make the witnesses state their names and professions, although he regularly has a great deal of difficulty with this task due to the often rather eccentric characters called as witnesses in his cases.

name: Kosaburou
about: Very little is known about Kosaburo's early life. At one point in time, he was training to become a Rocket member at the same time as Musashi, Kojiro, and Yamato. Yamato and Kosaburo were assigned together and now work as a team, capturing Pokémon for Team Rocket. There is a running gag, in which other characters usually call him by an incorrect name.  Strangely, Kosaburo was not seen with Pokémon in his possession until his third appearance; before that time, Yamato had always been the one to battle with her Pokémon. Kosaburo, however, has other skills typical of Rockets, including disguise and some physical prowess. He was able to pick up and throw Musashi into a wall.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Yamato
about: Yamato and Musashi are rivals. Their back-and-forth banter, in which they are very candid about their dislike for the other, has revealed that they knew each other when they were young. Many fans have speculated that the two women were once friends. This theory would be logical, as since both women clearly knew each other and both women chose to join Team Rocket, it would make sense that Yamato, as was the case with Musashi, had at least one parent who was a Team Rocket Agent.  In a Battle Frontier episode, Takeshi falls for Yamato who is disguised as Nurse Joy, but senses something wrong with her due to his innate knowledge of the Joys.  (Source: Wikipedia, edited)

Under stress, Sakaeguchi is known to get diarrhea, a trait revealed to everyone by Abe, who noticed it during their high school entrance exams. As a batter, Sakaeguchi is exceptionally good at bunting and usually bats in the leadoff position.

Dr. Casella treated Alfredo's younger sister as his real daughter. Every Saturday, the doctor goes to an orphanage and examines children.

name: Nice
about: The impulsive half of the "Minimum Holder PI duo" along with his partner Murasaki. He is constantly broke for money, partly due to the fact that he doesn't care about the cost of a job request more than what it entails.  He is a bit absent minded at times with little regard for whatever situation he is immediately in such as when he tries withdrawing cash during a bank robbery with armed thieves. Despite his seemingly carefree nature, he is a genius thinker and able to quickly assess information.

name: Murasaki
about: The rather reserved other half of the "Minimum Holder PI duo" along with his partner, Nice. He is a rational thinker and unlike Nice, prioritizes the cost of a job request over content. He has a bit of an existentialist outlook on things.  His Holder ability is activated when he removes his glasses.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hajime
about: Hajime is an amnesiac and a gluttonous girl who eats a lot and often. She spends most of her time at the Nowhere Café.  She suffers from memory loss. At first, she seems ordinary, but her minimum is revealed to be enhanced speed, strength, and regeneration. It is not explained how she activates her minimum until the second season (Re: Hamatora).

name: Art
about: The superintendent of the Yokohama Police Department. Art is generally calm with a kind demeanor and possesses a strong sense of justice. He is old friends with Nice and Honey. Despite not being a Minimum Holder, he is a graduate from the Facultas Academy from which he assisted his late younger brother. He also likes sweets.

name: Koneko
about: Koneko acts as Hamatora's receptionist and contract negotiator. She receives job requests which she then explains and assigns to the members of the agency.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Hikaru Souma

name: Scara
about: Scara is a merchant, a shop owner in Sonogno Village. He is the father of Embellino. Mr. Scara prosecuted a collaborative coercion operation with Luini, the "God of Death." He was the one who encouraged Romeo to sign a contract with the "God of Death." After Romeo signed a contract, Scara fetched Dr. Baregi in Locarno and brought him to Sonogno so that Romeo's father, Roberto, can be treated for his illness.

name: Embellino
about: Embellino is the son of Mr. Scara, a merchant in Sonogno Village. He has a crush on Anita. Embellino competed with Romeo, Marco and Mannio Piccalio in the Hero's Tree Climb. During the event, Embellino cheated, but it was Romeo who became the last man on the tree.

name: Amon
nicknames: Angel of Time, God of Trickery, God of Mischief, God of Deceit, The Blasphemer, Lil’ Raven, Mr. Er
about: Name: Amon Birthday: January 3th, Third Epoch Age: 2584+ Height: 1.85 m (6 ft 1 in)  Amon, also known as the Angel of Time, was one of the Kings of Angels from the Third Epoch and a child of the Ancient Sun God. "He" was born as a Sequence 1 Worm of Time with the Uniqueness of the Error Pathway.  According to the doctrines from the Third Epoch, the Ancient Sun God once referred to Amon as the God of Trickery, the God of Mischief, and the light at the dawn of the apocalypse.  In Fall of 1352, "He" advanced to a Sequence 0 Error by replacing Mr. Door in "His" Apotheosis Ritual. Shortly after, "He" accommodated the Uniqueness of the Door Pathway as well as a Key of Stars Beyonder characteristic and ascended to a Dual-Pathway True God.  With a crystal monocle in "his" right eye, curly hair, a black cloak, and a pointed hat, "he" is a high-sequence Beyonder and one of the main antagonists in Lord of the Mysteries.  "He" has no common ethics and just pursues stimulation and pleasure. "He" sees everything and everyone as his toys. As a natural born mythical creature, in his eyes humans are nothing but toys.  "He" is good at deceit and prefers using fraud rather than straight-up violence to achieve "His" goal. "His" words can be very persuasive and "He" often misled others by speechcraft.  However, Amon first and foremost values "His" own life. "His" deceitful, fraudulent, and reckless attitude is but a cover.  (Source: Lotm Wiki)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

After William re-encourages him, he becomes the Paladin's squire and travelling companion.  (Source: Wikipedia)

He often fights with Viola as she does not want him to get close to Alyssa, but in truth is fond of her and thinks of her as family too.

name: Kouichi Hayase
about: Kouichi is a junior-high school student who dreams of being a hero someday. One day he encounters an accident in which a gigantic humanoid called “LINEBARREL” falls right out of the sky. He subsequently becomes what people refer to as a “Factor”, a pilot of the mecha whose life goes hand-in-hand with the life of the mecha he pilots. Kouichi obtains extraordinary physical strength as a result of becoming a Factor. This drastic change gives Kouichi excessive confidence, making him arrogant and aggressive.

name: Emi Kizaki
about: A girl who has completely lost her memory except for her name. She seems to have some secret past related to LINEBARREL but it remains unknown.

name: Reiji Moritsugu
about: The chief of JUDA Corporation’s Special Task Force who is also a factor that pilots the machina “VARDANT”. An all-around player who excels in intelligence, leadership and physical strength. He is an expert in battles who never loses his cool and always makes sound judgments. He always dresses in suave business suits.

name: Bus Driver
about: A mysterious, unnamed bus driver who seems to know more than he reveals and constantly shows up to offer advice to Tsukune, he is usually portrayed smoking a cigar. He is the one who requests the board chairman help keep Tsukune's ghoulish nature at bay. It is unknown if the bus driver is human or a yokai, but he does have an extensive knowledge in the supernatural, having identified Ishigami's Lilith Mirror as the cause of the uproar during the school festival. He seems to know about Tsukune secretly being a human being, but it is only subtly implied.   (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Risky
about: A shinigami in training, Risky takes to her job quite gleefully. She is robed in a skull studded black outfit with a jewel in the center, long black stockings, and a large hat that looks like a cross between a ten gallon hat and a stereotypical witch's hat. She has black hair and dark blue-grey eyes. She wields a scythe that, among other things, can take the souls of the living who are filled with sadness, present illusions dealing with the cause of the current target's sadness, and act as a microphone. Risky isn't as cruel as she leads people to think, since she tried to undo the damage she did in Moe's room when she first arrived when she was given a new assignment.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Safety
about: An angel in training, Safety takes just as much joy bringing happiness and blessings as Risky does taking souls. She wears a simple white robe, with a small jewel and collar as the only things that stick out. She also has a jewel on her forehead. She has long blue-green hair, which she ties up in pink bands, and slightly darker blue-green eyes. She is near-sighted, so she must wear glasses. She can summon a bow and arrow which acts like Cupid's arrow, causing anyone to fall in love with the first person they see. Thanks to a passing ambulance, she hit a neighbor's dog, Lani, with it.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Moe Katsuragi
about: She starts off in the series depressed because the boy she likes seemed to be interested in other women. This depression summoned Risky. Thanks to a small complement to Risky, Safety took over and set the record straight.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: M1
about: M1, M2, and M3 are members of Team Ichigaki in the Dark Tournament. Their real names, however, are, in order, Yen, Kai, and Ryo. Every since they were children they were trained by their master, Mitamura, and learned martial arts. However, when Dr. Ichigaki poisoned their master, the three gave their freedom up to get Ichigaki to heal their master. Dr. Ichigaki then implanted Blood-Slaver Nodes, which can only be removed at the cost of their host's life, on their backs, putting them under his complete control and largely increasing their strength. Their souls remained trapped inside and unable to do anything, although all three wanted to be free of Ichigaki at all cost, even death. Their souls did have some abilities, however, as shown by how they sent Kuwabara a message in their dreams explaining their pasts. All three of them are very skilled. M2 and M3's attacks are invisible to those without sufficient spirit training, in contrast M1 distracts the enemies with visible attacks. They fight extremely efficiently as a team, using their attacks to cover each other and keep their opponents on the defensive.  The three make their first appearance during the preliminaries, where they win their matches without a single loss and easily kill a member of the opposing team who tried to kill them. The next day, while Kuwabara was sleeping, they sent a message to him that explained how they became Ichigaki's servants. In the Dark Tournament pairing, Team Ichigaki is the first team they fight during the main tournament and have a team battle with them against Yusuke, Kuwabara, and Genkai, where Yusuke and Kuwabara were initially unable to see though their attacks at all. Under Ichigkai's commands, they neutralize Kuwabara from fighting, and the anger at Ichigaki gives Yusuke the ability to see though their techniques and attack them successfully. Genkai then used a special technique that gave their souls the strength to choose if they are corrupt or pure, and their souls removed the Nodes without killing their bodies, winning the match for Team Urameshi. Although at first they felt that they should not be allowed to see their master, Genkai explained to them how they were healed, and Mitamura forgave them. Kai then attempted to take Kuwabara's place in Team Urameshi to make it up to them, though the tournament rules forbade it. It is also shown that all three of them and their master made it out of the arena alive after the final matches.

about: A dog that, thanks to Safety's arrow, is infatuated with Risky and Safety.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Kaizan Doshi
about: Kaizan Doshi is the Jester who helps Oomidou Setsuna in her plans of world domination. He was the former rebel leader known as "Mountain Templar," who a year and a half before the final episode, led the rebel army over Mt. Charanbo and onto White Wizard Lake in their march on the capital. His fate was unknown after Suirou's attack on the rebel boats left only a few survivors, including Yajiro, who greatly respected him. Although his main weapon is an Enlightened Evil gun, which utilizes a highly-accelerated column of compressed air to cut-down his victims, Kaizan is a skilled swordsman. He also has the ability to teleport and can fly using specialized boots. He had been evil for at least ten years.

name: Kikuko Inoue
about: She always calls herself "17 years old" (井上喜久子１７歳です). Fans would refute her jokingly with "Oi! Oi!" (roughly equivalent to "yeah right"). To further promote her ideal, she founded a "cult" of "17-year-olds" (Juu-nana-sai Kyou, １７歳教). Current cult members include Yukari Tamura, Sakura Nogawa, Rina Satou, and Yui Horie.

name: Manami Ookusa
about: A married high-schooler who works multiple jobs to pay off her husband's debts. Her name derives from okusama-nami (奥様な身, "a married person").  It is revealed in episode 5 of Zan that her husband is unfaithful and she's aware of it.

name: Zeru
about: Zeru is the "Captain" Of Jolly Devil Six. His power is based around fire (火炎術), his only attacks he uses are Fire Aura, and a fire blast attack. He seemingly punches Hiei through the stomach, then shoots a fire blast at him, yet again seemingly killing him. Then Hiei appears behind Zeru, stunning him as he doesn't realize that a fire-based attack won't work on other fire demons. Thus he is killed by the infamous Black Dragon Hell Fire (Jao Ensatsu Koku Ryu Ha) (referred to as Dragon of the Darkness Flame in the English version). Upper C class demon.

name: Uraurashima
about: Uraurashima a.k.a. Reverse Urashima (English manga) is a member of the Fractured Fairy Tales. He fights Kurama in the Semi-Finals. He tricks Kurama into believing that he's fighting against his will, and uses the Idunn Box (Reverse Treasure Box) in an attempt to turn him back into a helpless baby before killing him. The magic works too well however, turning Kurama back into the ruthless Yoko thief, who attempts to torture him to learn the secrets of the Idunn box. He was killed by Shishiwakamaru when he threw his sword into the barrier and impaled him in the neck before he could tell. He is then revealed to be a disguised lesser demon. His character is based on the tale of Urashima Tarou.

name: Gonzou Tarukane
about: Gonzo Tarukane is a very rich man who kidnaps Yukina. Sakyo ordered Younger Toguro to kill him. In the Filipino dub he is known as "Don Paquito Quito" which is most likely a reference to filipino actor paquito diaz, who is himself famous for playing screen villain roles.

name: Suzuki
about: Suzuki, Suzuka in the English version, is a member of the Fractured Fairy Tales. In the past he was known as Tanaka the Powerful Warrior, and one day lost miserably against Younger Toguro. Suzuki is, at first, very selfish and seems to care only about himself, as shown by how he thought he was extremely beautiful and everyone else was ugly. He even went so far as to kill several people in the audience at the Dark Tournament for refusing to worship him. It is later found out that he does care for others, and he was kind enough to help Kazuma Kuwabara and Kurama during the Finals Rounds of the Dark Tournament. He is also extremely intelligent, having knowledge of many moves and abilities. Suzuki is also regularly seen dressed up as a clown. In the anime, as a clown his hair is blond, but when not dressed up as a clown it is more along the lines of brown with some minor green shading in it. Suzuki is a master of disguise, and is also extremely skilled at creating weapons for the advantage of others. Suzuki's main abilities are based around manipulating his spirit energy into powerful blasts.

name: Seiryuu
about: Seiryuu is the third member of the Four Beasts. A dragon demon, he is extremely fast and capable of emitting youki to turn the opponent into ice. In the manga he is promptly chopped into pieces by Hiei before he can attack him, making him the swiftest-defeated Saint Beast (though due to Hiei's skill, not due to being weak). In the anime, however, he proves to be a dangerous foe, nearly defeating Hiei before being killed himself. Middle C class demon.

name: Sakyou
about: Sakyou is the owner and leader of Team Toguro in the Dark Tournament. He is a very rich man, having gained his wealth from gambling all his life. He is usually a very calm, collected, and intelligent person while keeping his evil side influencing his outside self. For both the Rescue Yukina arcs and Dark Tournament Saga, Sakyou made few appearances, but in truth was the real villain of both arcs, merely using Team Toguro as his own personal puppets, although it appears none of the characters realized this.  Sakyou was once one of five siblings, but unlike his siblings, he "veered from the norm". While his siblings became civil servants, he began to gain mental insanity and coveted blood. Over a three year period, he slowly moved from dissecting frogs and fish, to cats and dogs, and finally real humans. Soon he entered the gambling business, using a key strategy to help him win by threatening to wager his life. Most of the time the others quit when they saw he was serious, but this was suspected five times. He states one time was up against the Black Book Club, or BBC, which he was a former member of, and the last this was suggested, coincidentally the last time he wagered his life, was during the final rounds of the Dark Tournament. It is sometime in his gambling life he became a member of the BBC.  Sometime during his membership, former Spirit Detective Shinobu Sensui had witnessed an experiment the BBC were doing, Sakyo included. They had made several humans slaughter demons taken from a portal between the human and demon planes, and the humans then bathed in their blood. Angry, Sensui killed all of the humans, and began to question humanity.

name: Ruka

name: Roto

The three girls controlling Mimika  had agreed to stop playing The World when they graduated from high school, and after the death of Mimika they indeed never played again. In the anime, Tanaka is shown as loving music and she has a radio with headphones so that she can listen without Fuzuki knowing; Mitsuki sometimes uses this to blackmail Tanaka. Tanaka also has a crush on Wakaoji and is jealous of Oshige, mistakenly believing her to be Wakaoji's fiancée. In one episode, she challenges Oshige to a contest to see which of the two would make a better bride. Although Tanaka wins all events, she concedes contest when she sees Wakaoji and Oshige laughing together, believing the two are in love.

Though he can be blunt, he never seems to mean any harm and adopts a playful attitude towards most things. She is very loyal to Suzaku, and only follows his orders. Murugu was ultimately killed along with her master when Yusuke's final attack destroyed both of them, The Makai whistle, and much of Suzaku's tower.

name: Bakken
about: Bakuken is the third fighter on the Shadow Channelers (Team Masho), a hulking brute with little brains or honor. Thanks to the Shadow Channelers' owner, Bakken was able to fight against Kurama, who was unconscious from the previous round. Yusuke was ready to break the rules to save Kurama, but luckily Risho ordered Bakken to stop. Bakken then faced Yusuke next but it didn't take long for Yusuke to defeat him. His power is 'water manipulation', which he uses to create a dense fog out from his sweat to conceal himself. However, it does not work if he is sweating cold - like after Yusuke punched his ribs. D class demon.

name: Byakko
about: Byakko is the second of the Four Beasts, a large tiger demon who can absorb reiki into his body to make himself stronger. He battles with Kuwabara twice -- first on the battlements of the Saint Beasts' castle, where Kuwabara defeats him by overstuffing his body with his own reiki, and again in his own lair, falling into the lava and apparently dying. He reappears once more, begging the third Saint Beast Seiryu for help; however, he is frozen by his Seiryu, his fellow Saint Beast and shattered into shards of ice, an ignominious end to his life. Lower C class demon.

name: Dr. Ichigaki
about: Dr. Ichigaki is a demon scientist who took advantage of three martial art students by poisoning their master. Dr. Ichigaki then appeared and offered to heal their master if they agreed to participate in an experiment of his. Dr. Ichigaki turned them into Makai minions (Usually called M1, M2, M3, or Dr. Ichigaki's minions). After his team's defeat in the tournament, he unveils a serum ("Instant Gene Therapy") which almost instantly enhances him into a monster form, but is creamed by Yusuke just as quickly. In the manga he is confirmed to be alive.

name: Elder Toguro
about: Elder Toguro is the oldest of the Toguro Brothers. He is very tiny, and usually rides on Younger Toguro's shoulder instead of walking. He is much more unpleasant than his younger brother, and can manage to anger the usually calm Younger Toguro. His goal in the tournament was to have every member of Team Urameshi dead, as well as their friends. In the second Character Popularity Polls in Japan, he was at 11th place with 421 votes.  Elder Toguro, along side his brother and Genkai, built a dojo together. After Kairen's attack, the three entered the Dark Tournament. After winning, the two wished to become demons. Sometime after this, they both became servants of Sakyo.  Elder Toguro's main ability is body manipulation, or rather changing the shape of it. He can reorganize the location of his bodily organs and shape himself into weapons for his brother, like swords or spears. He can create drills from his fingers and swords from his arm, and can also make "puppets" by transforming his arm into a miniature person. He also has very powerful regenerative abilities, managing to reform after being severed and attaining basic immortality.  Elder Toguro first appeared with his brother under Gonzo's leadership. When they fought against Kuwabara and Yusuke, Elder Toguro took the shape of a sword for his brother. After that he only makes a few background appearances until the final round.

name: Juri
about: Juri is the referee of the Dark Tournament after Koto was forced to switch to commentary. She is apparently a sea-creature demon. She is an idol in the human and demon planes. Towards the end of the Dark Tournament, she complains that she will die a virgin, but in the Makai Tournament, Koto implies that she got "what she wanted", and there is an extra scene showing Juri watching the tournament with a demon with a mustache, presumably her husband.

name: Masami Hirukawa
about: Masami is the father of Taeko and a corrupt police officer. He takes bribes and loans money from Yakuza, but when the time comes to pay them back, he begs for more time. With no other choice, he turns to robbery and other crimes. He alienates his daughter by putting a hidden camera in her room. He says he has no more chances of advancing in the force, and in order to make the life of his family he turns to mugging. Eventually, he starts taking drugs in order to cope with the immense pressure.   One evening on a way home, Hirukawa gets a chance to catch "Shonen Bat".

name: Excel Kobayashi
about: The animated version of one of the two singers that sing the opening and closing songs. Represented here as two publicity seeking singers who look remarkably like Excel and Hyatt. The most major episode featuring them is the bowling episode but they also appear several other times such as in the first recap/new years show. Excel Kobayashi is the one in the left of the picture

name: Jorge Saotome
about: Jorge Saotome is an oni working with Koenma as his personal assistant whenever Botan is on Earth. Koenma sometimes clashes with him and primarily vents his anger on him if he is anxious over a situation. In the second to last episode of the anime, it is revealed that he is also the narrator of the series, a joke on how they have the same voice actor. In the English version he is referred as Ogre or Blue Ogre and rarely by name.

name: Butajiri
about: The owner of Team Masho, he is killed by Toguro when he cheated several times against Team Urameshi. In the English anime version, Butujiri also stated that he wanted to get revenge against Yusuke whom he believed was responsible for Tarukane's death but is informed by Sakyo that it was Younger Toguro who was responsible, seconds before Toguro killed Butujiri.

name: Gama
about: Gama is a member of the Shadow Channelers (Team Masho) whose speciality is the "secret art" of make-up, using paint made of blood to bring out spiritual abilities and increase strength. His two known attacks are the Make-up of Chains (Gokujono Sho) and the Make-up of the Seal (Nembaku Fuji no Sho). He fights Kurama in the opening team match, and uses his attacks to chain Kurama down and then seal his yōki (aura, or demon energy) within him. Kurama's only choice, because of the Gokujo no Sho, is to use his hair to swing his Rose instead of his arms. He ends up killing Gama, and becomes unable to move off of the arena, and ends up fighting three consecutive matches.

name: Gokumonki
about: Gokumonki is the third and final member of the Triad working for Tarukane. In the manga he is defeated by Kuwabara and Yusuke so quickly that he's never even given a chance to introduce himself. However, in the anime he was able to fight them by taking Botan hostage and using her as a shield to keep them from attacking. He was struck by both Yusuke and Kuwabara at the same time when she managed to slip out of his clutches though

name: Sukezo Gondawara
about: The owner of Team Rokuyukai, he doesn't do much research and pays the price.

name: Inmaki
about: Inmaki is another member of the Triad working for Tarukane. In addition to wielding razor-sharp claws, Inmaki possesses a magic cloak that can turn him invisible by flipping it over himself. Although the most powerful of the triad, he is quickly dispatched by a combo of Kuwabara's senses and Yusuke's Spirit Shotgun.

name: Koto
about: Koto is the referee in the Dark Tournament. She is a fox demon like Kurama, but seems to have no special abilities. She is later replaced by Juri and switches to commentary. She was also the referee in the Makai Tournament. She is an idol in both the human and demon planes. She seems to have a crush on Kurama's demon form, Yoko.  Koto often seemed overly amused by the suffering of the fighters in the Dark Tournament, leading to her looking like a mean character. However, she later reveals that she can only enjoy brutality when both contestants can fight back. During the tournament, she begins a ten-count in an attempt to stop Bakken from beating up Kurama- showing that she is not totally sadistic. She also has the entire tournament rule book memorized.  Koto is briefy the object of affection for Chu, whom she doesn't share feelings for. She sometimes puts on a cute act, but is very shrewd and manages to get in jabs at Juri being a former 'cocktail waitress'.

name: Kuromomotarou
about: Kuromomotarou a.k.a. Dark Peach Boy or Poison Peach Boy (English manga) uses one of the first of many strange items from the Fractured Fairy Tales, enchanted Millet Dumplings. First he turns himself into a monstrous ape (Buju Soko: Maen No So (Beast Skin: Armor of the Demon Monkey), then a bird (Buju Soko: Machi No So (Beast Skin: Armor of the Demon Bird) and finally a wolf (Buju Soko: Maken No So (Beast Skin: Armor of the Demon Wolf). Before using each of these, he allows Hiei to attack him, thus learning each attacks' strengths and weaknesses so when his body takes on a new form it can be immune to those attacks. Hiei defeats him using the Jaou Ensatsu Ken ("Sword of darkness flame"). His character is based on the tale of Momotarou. C class demon.

name: Makintarou
about: Makintarou a.k.a. Evil Kintaro (English manga) - The first fighter for the Fractured Fairy Tales, he had no enchanted items in battle. He fought against Hiei in the first round. Hiei took off his forearm so fast that Makintarou did not notice until he pointed out. He then grew his "Axe Blade Fist" from his stump and slashed straight through Hiei. He truly only slashed through Hiei's afterimage. Hiei then skewered his sword from the top of his head straight down through his jaw, killing him instantly. His character is based on the tale of Kintarou.

name: Mitamura
about: The martial arts master of M1, M2, and M3. For years, Mitamura had been training young boys throughout their lives in the ways of martial arts, though one day Dr. Ichigaki poisoned him in secrecy. His disciples, gravely upset, were willing to do anything for his health, and Dr. Ichigaki took three of his students, En, Ryo, and Kai, and turned them into killing machines at his command. Kurama, finding this out through one of Dr. Ichigaki's henchmen, healed Mitamura. Although the three felt their master should not see them for the crimes they committed, Genkai explained that she had given them the choice to be purified or not, and Mitamura easily forgave them.

name: Tomomi Nomiya
about: On the surface, Nomiya seems to be the proto-typical delinquent—he wears an afro, has dropped out of high school, and pauses to defecate on the school steps before leaving for good. It soon becomes clear, however, that Nomiya suffers from crushing guilt over a traffic accident he caused which cost a girl (Yamashita Yasumi) the use of her legs. While only an average student, Nomiya was obsessed with basketball, and not being able to play on the school team has left him directionless and without joy. While taking the paraplegic and seemingly catatonic Yasumi for a walk, Nomiya overhears the sounds of Togawa playing basketball. Starved for playing time, Nomiya challenges Togawa to a game and comes away impressed by Togawa's skill and determination. Soon, Nomiya becomes something of a cheerleader/mascot for the Tigers and a friend to Togawa. Even though he rarely gets a chance to actually play basketball, it seems to be enough for Nomiya to be around others that do.    (Source: Wikipedia)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Lake Toya
about: The Spirit of Lake Toya possesses the sword that Gintoki carries. Appearing in Chapter 150, he attempted to teach the Yorozuya an ultimate technique, the "Jumbolic Magnum," which sends the target flying into the sky with a single punch. A side-effect of the attack forces the victim to shed bodily fluids from his body. Unfortunately, none of the gang ever manage to learn the attack.  The spirit lives with his parents. His mother has an afro hairstyle with a white beard, and his father is constantly looking for a job. His father also has a sure kill technique, called the "Jack Nicolle," in which he shoots a beam from his bald spot. Toya also keeps a pet, and it sheds a large amount of curly hair. It is said that he was a fellow student to Taikobou, the main character of Hoshin Engi.  Lake Toya enjoys eating fried cuttlefish, as evidenced by the contents of his wastebasket. He claims the contents of his trash, strange smelling hardened tissue paper, are the remnants of the occasional cuttlefish feast, although Gintoki thinks otherwise. The spirit does keep a book collection of female figurines under his bed.  He is a parody of the character Zangetsu from manga Bleach.

name: Tomoyo Kurobe
about: Tomoyo is Hiromi's friend whom she often hangs out with and fellow member of the girl's basketball team. She is sure that Hiromi likes Shinichirō, but Hiromi constantly denies it.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Ruweek Hartain
name_kanji: ルイーク＝ハルトアイン

name: Piros
about: Piros (ぴろし) fills the role of a comic relief in the .hack//Games, which is most apparent in his encounters with Mia. He is the second player to join Kite and BlackRose.

name: Uchiyama
about: Uchiyama or Utchy (ウッチー) of Bandai is a System Administrator that appears with Emi in front of Balmung in .hack//GIFT to inform him that the dungeon Balmung is exploring is experiencing technical difficulties. Uchiyama then spouts nonsense, confusing Balmung. Uchiyama is named after and voiced by .hack producer Daisuke Uchiyama. Uchiyamada@Bandai, who sends the clear flag emails in the Japanese version of the games, is also based on him. His eyes are censored as a gag, because he is a caricature of a real person.

name: Drunk
about: A drunk man from episodes 4 and 12.

name: Ichiro Sato
about: While Ichiro is an experienced hacker, he does not possess a character in The World. He leaves all business inside the game to Helba, while he works outside of the game in the real world.

name: Kaoru Asaba
about: Kaoru Asaba (浅羽 -) is the woman that helps Yuki Aihara escape from the malfunctioning Y-Port World Center. A rather strong and resourceful woman. Near the end of the episode, it is revealed that she is a friend of Yuki's sister-in-law Miho.

name: Miho Aihara
about: Miho Aihara (相原美穂) is Yuki Aihara's sister-in-law.

name: Masaya Makino
about: Masaya Makino (牧野雅弥) is a friend of Mai Minase and Tomonari Kasumi. He is a member of their school's gaming club with Tomonari. While he has a character in The World, the name of it is unknown.

name: Tomonari Kasumi
about: Sieg (ジーク) is the character used by Tomonari Kasumi (香住 智成), the boyfriend of Mai Minase and one of the coma victims attacked by Skeith. He fell to Skeith when he invited Mai to play The World.

name: Lisa Oakwood
name_kanji: リーザ・オークウッド
about: Luke's childhood friend who wanted to be a knight and protect everyone in the city.  Cecily strongly reminds Luke of her.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name: Golg Boddole Zer
about: Boddole Zer is the supreme commander of the 4,795,122-ship Boddole Zer Main Fleet belonging to the main antagonists, the Zentradi.  Golg Boddole Zer ordered his subordinate Britai Kridanik to track down and recover the Supervision Army spaceship which had crashlanded on Earth, thus starting Space War I. After the failures of Britai and his other subordinate Moruk Lap Lamiz to capture the SDF-1 Macross  and their subsequent "cultural contamination" by the miclones, Bodole Zer ordered all 4,795,122 ships in the Boddole Zer Main Fleet to fold to Earth  and destroy the SDF-1 Macross, the defecting Zentradi forces, and the Earth itself in 2010.  Boddole Zer was killed when his massive flagship was destroyed in an unorthodox tactic by the SDF-1 Macross, but not before he ordered the obliteration of the Earth's surface with less than one million human survivors in the Battle with the Boddole Zer Main Fleet.

name: Kaifun Lynn
about: Lynn Kaifun is Lynn Minmay's older cousin. He is a dedicated pacifist and opposes war in all forms.

name: Kim Kabirov
about: A crew member in charge of the radar and communication.

name: Shammy Milliome
about: Shammy Milliome is a member of the bridge crew on the SDF-1.

name: Vanessa Laird
name_kanji: ヴァネッサ・レイアード
about: A crew member on the bridge.

name: Colonel Felme
about: A blue-haired Digald pilot who pilots Bio-Ptera, a flying Digald Zoid. She likes taking bubble baths alot and seems comfortable with men seeing her naked as she is seen many times having conversations with men while she is in a bathtub. She's often teamed up with Souta to help defeat the Digald Suppression Army, but she only considers her partner as a tool. She was actually a citizen of Sora city like Jiin, sent to watch Digald, but turned against her former home out of sheer boredom. Towards the end of the war, she defected and saved Zairin from certain death while facing Jiin. Her last act of goodwill would be flying in to save Souta (renamed Gin); she was ultimately killed when Jiin, in his Bio-Tyranno, threw Souta's Lanstag's lance at her Bio-Ptera..  She is Voiced by: Mako Hyōdō (Japanese), Tara Platt (English).

name: Sle-Ghi Baek
about: A big breasted, beautiful girl. She often helps her parents in their dumpling store, when she does, the male customers flood in.  She usually trips over because her view get blocked by her big breasts, and she found a similarity between herself and Yong who always trips over because of his overweight belly. She enjoys reading romance novels.  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Souichirou Kurebayashi
about: Souichirou Kurebayashi is the deceased brother of the main character, Teru Kurebayashi. Little is known about him other than he was a very talented computer engineer and led a team of engineers that included Tasuku Kurosaki and Riko Onizuka, he supposedly made some software that would sell for a very high price before his death which mysteriously disappeared, this has brought suspicion on the phone he left his little sister, many believing the software was left to her as a sort of uninformed inheritance. He shoved the role of DAISY onto his friend Kurosaki and potentially convinced him using some form of guilt as Kurosaki has openly admitted that he was in some way responsible for Souichirou's death though the contribution is unclear. It was thought that Souichirou was the one who named DAISY after his sisters favorite flower, the blue daisy, however DAISY has admitted to taking on the name after discovering it was the name of a deadly bomb. It is Kurosaki’s codename that he used to hack into illegal government services. Even though Kurosaki stopped hacking, DAISY is still known to be a "genius hacker", thus causing many troubles for Teru when a "fake DAISY" appears.   (Source: Wikipedia)  No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

name: Sesshoumaru's Mother
about: A powerful dog demon and Sesshomaru's mother, was introduced in the 466th chapter of the InuYasha manga. She appears in the episode 9 of InuYasha: The Final Act.  Sesshomaru's mother is an inuyoukai like her deceased mate, the Inu no Taishou. As such, she can transform into a giant dog demon as well as having more human appearance. As the mate of the Lord of the Western lands, Inu no Taishou, she is the Lady of the Western lands. She holds the Meidou Stone, which was given to her by Inu no Taisho. He told her that if Sesshomaru were to come by, to use it and "If you use Meidou-Stone Sesshomaru will be faced with great danger... However, you must not feel fear or sadness." This apparently was another of the Great Dog Demon's tests for his sons.  In demeanor she seems similar to Sesshomaru, albeit with a certain playfulness, and probably influenced his initial attitude towards humans; observing Rin and Kohaku following Sesshomaru, she inquires casually if he is planning to eat them. Observing Sesshomaru's trial after activating the Meidou Stone, she seems at best only casually concerned about the possibility of his death, and after he refuses the escape route she offers, she seems mildly offended, complaining that, unlike his father, he "completely lacks any charm."  However, she does feel concern for her son's well-being, as seen when she brings Rin back to life using the Meidou-Seki after witnessing his reaction to her death, and later when she questions Jaken in whether or not Sesshomaru was happy now that Rin was brought back. She appears in episode nine "Sesshomaru in the Underworld" of the second anime series "Inuyasha: The Final Act."  Although she is a daiyoukai, she is shown to have a good heart, chiding Sesshomaru for seeking to perfect the Tenseiga as a weapon of destruction rather than a weapon of healing. She also lectures him about the qualities of the wielder of the Tenseiga, emphasizing the need for compassion, love and a pure heart. This could mean that she bears no ill-grudge towards her former mate; rather, she still nurses deep feelings towards him. She also stays in a large castle.

about: Sumeragi aims to become the world's strongest!  He has been practicing Haikaiken, the skill his father passed down to him, since he was 13 years old.
